extracted.intended_audience: students and readers of political and philosophical theory
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and critical standards for judging the nature, method, and social role of philosophy, religion, and political doctrines; distinguishes 'true' philosophy from vain/traditional/Aristotelian excesses and outlines political/moral implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: What Philosophy Is
rubrics_metrics.description: By Philosophy is understood "the Knowledge acquired by Reasoning, from the Manner of the Generation of any thing, to the Properties; or from the Properties, to some possible Way of Generation of the same; to the end to bee able to produce, as far as matter, and humane force permit, such Effects, as humane life requireth."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: the Geometrician reasons from construction to properties and back to construction (measuring land), the Astronomer reasons from motions of heavenly bodies to causes of seasons and timekeeping. Philosophy is knowledge derived by causal or constructive reasoning aimed at producing useful effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prudence No Part Of Philosophy
rubrics_metrics.description: Prudence (original knowledge called Experience) is not part of philosophy because it is not attained by Reasoning, but is a memory of successions of events and therefore contingent and particular rather than general and immutable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish between reasoning-based, general truths (philosophy) and experience-based, contingent practical knowledge (prudence); the latter is useful but not philosophical knowledge.

rubrics_metrics.name: No False Doctrine Is Part Of Philosophy
rubrics_metrics.description: Nor are we therefore to give that name to any false Conclusions: For he that Reasoneth aright in words he understandeth, can never conclude an Error.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Philosophy (proper reasoning) should not yield false conclusions; if a doctrine is false it should not be labelled genuine philosophy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revelation Is Not Philosophy
rubrics_metrics.description: Nor to that which any man knows by supernaturall Revelation; because it is not acquired by Reasoning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Knowledge claimed via supernatural revelation is excluded from the domain of philosophy, since philosophy requires reasoning from causes/effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority-Based Learning Is Not Philosophy
rubrics_metrics.description: Nor that which is gotten by Reasoning from the Authority of Books; because it is not by Reasoning from the Cause to the Effect, nor from the Effect to the Cause; and is not Knowledge, but Faith.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learning that rests on deference to authors rather than causal reasoning should be treated as faith or opinion, not philosophical knowledge.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leisure and Commonwealth Required for Philosophy
rubrics_metrics.description: Leasure is the mother of Philosophy; and Common-wealth, the mother of Peace, and Leasure: Where first were great and flourishing Cities, there was first the study of Philosophy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Philosophy requires social conditions (peace, leisure, organized commonwealths) that free minds from subsistence struggles so they can reason and form schools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geometry as Foundation of Natural Philosophy
rubrics_metrics.description: Nature worketh by Motion; the Wayes, and Degrees whereof cannot be known, without the knowledge of the Proportions and Properties of Lines, and Figures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Natural philosophy must be grounded in geometry (quantitative/mathematical knowledge); without this, natural philosophy is likely to be speculative and unreliable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Moral Philosophy Must Ground on Civil Law, Not Private Taste
rubrics_metrics.description: For the rule of Manners, without Civill Government, is the Law of Nature; and in it, the Law Civill; that determineth what is Honest, and Dishonest; what is Just, and Unjust; and generally what is Good, and Evill: whereas they make the Rules of Good, and Bad, by their own Liking, and Disliking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In a commonwealth, measures of good and evil should be the law (public will), not private appetites or individual tastes; moral philosophy that reduces rules to personal liking is pernicious to the state.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logic Must Be Method, Not Captious Verbiage
rubrics_metrics.description: Their Logique which should bee the Method of Reasoning, is nothing else but Captions of Words, and Inventions how to puzzle such as should goe about to pose them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Logical method should clarify reasoning and avoid verbal tricks or sophistry that obscure rather than reveal causal relations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proper Purpose of Scriptural/Law Schools
rubrics_metrics.description: The reading of the Law... ought to have had no other end, but the acquainting of the people with the Commandements which they were to obey, and to expound unto them the writings of the Prophets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Synagogues/universities should teach the law to make the people obey and understand prophets, not to convert scripture-reading into abstruse, fantastical philosophy or vain traditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Universities' Actual Function and Philosophy's Subordination
rubrics_metrics.description: That which is now called an University, is a Joyning together... principal Schools were ordained for the three Professions... Romane Religion, of the Romane Law, and of the Art of Medicine. And for the study of Philosophy it hath no otherwise place, then as a handmaid to the Romane Religion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Universities historically serve professional theology, law, and medicine; the study called 'philosophy' in such institutions often functions merely as a handmaid to established religion (especially Aristotelianism), not as independent, true philosophy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reject Abstract/Separated Essences
rubrics_metrics.description: Wee are told, there be in the world certaine Essences separated from Bodies, which they call Abstract Essences, and Substantiall Formes... They are therefore no Names of Things; but Signes... and much absurdity follows (souls 'all of it in his little Finger', spirits without place, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The doctrine of separate abstract essences (substantial forms) is unintelligible and leads to absurd metaphysical conclusions and superstitions; do not accept such entities as real parts of the universe.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eternity Is Not a 'Nunc-stans' (Standing Present)
rubrics_metrics.description: For the meaning of Eternity, they will not have it to be an Endlesse Succession of Time... they will teach us, that Eternity is the Standing still of the Present Time, a Nunc-stans... which neither they, nor any else understand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conceptual devices like 'nunc-stans' that attempt to avoid temporal succession for eternity are unintelligible and should be treated skeptically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid Circular/Tautological Causes in Natural Philosophy
rubrics_metrics.description: The Schools will tell you... that the bodies that sink downwards, are Heavy; and that this Heavinesse is it that causes them to descend: But if you ask what they mean by Heavinesse, they will define it to bee an endeavour to goe to the center of the Earth: so that the cause why things sink downward, is an Endeavour to be below: which is as much as to say, that bodies descend, or ascend, because they doe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not accept explanations that merely rename the phenomenon as its cause (tautologies); satisfactory causes must explain, not restate, the effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do Not Invoke 'Ignorance' or 'Occult Qualities' as Causes
rubrics_metrics.description: In many occasions they put for cause of Naturall events, their own Ignorance, but disguised in other words: Fortune... Occult Qualities... Sympathy, Antipathy, Antiperistasis, Specificall Qualities...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid positing 'fortune' or unknown/occult qualities as causal explanations; such terms mask ignorance and hinder genuine inquiry into mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: State Law, Not Private Appetite, Measures Public Good
rubrics_metrics.description: Not the Appetite of Private men, but the Law, which is the Will and Appetite of the State is the measure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Political and moral judgments for a commonwealth should be grounded in the law/sovereign will (public will), not in the subjective appetites of individuals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marriage Is Lawful and Not Unchastity
rubrics_metrics.description: It is also Vain and false Philosophy, to say the work of Marriage is repugnant to Chastity, or Continence, and by consequence to make them Morall Vices; as they doe, that pretend Chastity, and Continence, for the ground of denying Marriage to the Clergy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deny the philosophical claim that lawful marriage is incompatible with chastity; priestly or religious prohibitions that label marriage as unchaste are not philosophically justified and have social/political motives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do Not Equate All Non-Popular Government With Tyranny
rubrics_metrics.description: From Aristotles Civill Philosophy, they have learned, to call all manner of Common-wealths but the Popular... Tyranny. All Kings they called Tyrants...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be wary of rhetorical misuse of terms (tyranny, tyranny of a few, anarchy) to attack political opponents; recognize the practical necessity of certain forms of arbitrary authority to maintain peace and law.

rubrics_metrics.name: Critique of 'Not Men, But Law Governs'
rubrics_metrics.description: And therefore this is another Errour of Aristotles Politiques, that in a wel ordered Common-wealth, not Men should govern, but the Laws.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The claim that laws, rather than men, govern a commonwealth is treated as erroneous here—implying that sovereign persons and institutions, not abstract laws alone, are necessary to make law operative and to secure order.
